faqs.question: What is the primary difference between Ne 30s Carded and Ne 30s Combed Cotton Yarn?
faqs.answer: Combed cotton yarn undergoes an additional combing process that removes short fibers (typically 12% to 18% noil extraction) and aligns the remaining long fibers in parallel. This results in significantly higher tensile strength (CSP), substantially lower hairiness, improved luster, and up to 50% fewer yarn imperfections (IPI) compared to carded yarn, making it the industry standard for high-end garments and fine weaving.
